module_summary: PicoRV32 AXI4-lite wrapper: the multi-cycle PicoRV32 core drives a native memory bus that an AXI adapter instance converts into AW/W/B/AR/R AXI4-lite channels.

anchors.name: mem_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: AXI write address from adapter, sourced from core mem_addr.

anchors.name: mem_axi_wdata
anchors.why: AXI write data from adapter, sourced from core store data.

anchors.name: mem_axi_araddr
anchors.why: AXI read address for instruction fetch and loads.

anchors.name: mem_axi_rdata
anchors.why: AXI read data returned through adapter as core mem_rdata.

anchors.name: mem_valid
anchors.why: Core native memory request valid driving adapter channel valids.

anchors.name: mem_ready
anchors.why: Adapter completion acknowledging core native memory transfer.

anchors.name: mem_addr
anchors.why: Core native bus address feeding AXI AW/AR addresses.

anchors.name: mem_wdata
anchors.why: Core native store data feeding AXI W channel.

anchors.name: mem_rdata
anchors.why: Read data from adapter into core for fetch/load.

anchors.name: mem_wstrb
anchors.why: Byte strobes; nonzero selects write vs read AXI transaction in adapter.

anchors.name: mem_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: AXI read address valid from adapter.

anchors.name: trap
anchors.why: Core trap indication on illegal instruction or fault.

anchors.name: mem_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: AXI write address valid from adapter.

anchors.name: mem_axi_wvalid
anchors.why: AXI write data valid from adapter.

anchors.name: mem_axi_bvalid
anchors.why: AXI write response valid completing writes in adapter.

anchors.name: mem_axi_rvalid
anchors.why: AXI read data valid completing reads in adapter.

anchors.name: mem_instr
anchors.why: Marks instruction fetch; sets AXI prot bits in adapter.

anchors.name: pcpi_valid
anchors.why: Coprocessor request valid; PCPI disabled by default parameter.

anchors.name: trace_valid
anchors.why: Trace stream valid; trace disabled by default parameter.

groups.name: cpu_core
groups.description: PicoRV32 multi-cycle core issuing native memory requests.

groups.name: axi_lite_adapter
groups.description: Converts native memory bus requests into AXI4-lite channels.
